# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat youth with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

He is a stolid young man who rarely laughs or chatters. He suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Traits

- stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- quiet and uncommunicative  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Billy drove Jane Andrews, Anne Shirley, and Diana Barry to a concert at White Sands in his double-seated buggy. He insisted that Anne sit beside him on the front seat during the drive because he admired her immensely and felt proud to have her riding next to him.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_
